endpoint: POST {API_URL}/internal/credit-events (implemented by apps/api, called by credit)
note: Sent once per credit event with header X-MS-Internal-Key. Body is the credit_event data from contracts/credit/events_sse.json. credit retries 3 times with backoff on non-2xx, then drops the event and logs it. id is unique per event, so api can ignore duplicates.

request.detail: Sent 820 XRP, 64% of the balance before the payment
